name: PageHeader
description: Page header for the React Native mobile app, 4 types: "left" (big title, optional collapsed compact row), "left-on-scroll" (compact left-aligned title), "center" (compact centered title), "search" (frosted search pill). Buttons/pill are a flat frosted-tint approximation (no expo-blur dependency yet).
notes: Web's collapse/type-change transitions (Framer Motion layout + crossfade) are dropped for a plain conditional render — no react-native-reanimated dependency for this. Glass buttons/pill approximate the backdrop blur with a flat AlphaWhite40 tint (no expo-blur dependency).
